title: I Walked Out to Meet It
summary: Tomas takes his little sister’s place on a winter walk to meet a masked creature, then hears someone calling from behind him in a voice he knows.
frame_0: Tomas raises his oil lantern beside his red scarf. The frost-crowned winter spirit leans over his shoulder, its blank white mask silhouetted against the moonlit firs. The title reads I WALKED OUT / TO MEET IT.
package_differences: Jake approved the original Reflection cast and the winter spirit's frost-branched mask. The opening uses steady shots, followed by a moving camera from 28.80 seconds. The covered lens conceals the return to the locked window.
The three shutters and the warm memories appear inside the continuing field shot. The sponsor edition continues into the 9.30-second Flashloop phone performance. The clean version ends in the field.
Both editions preserve all 7,112 original AAC story packets. The locked soundtrack measures -14.18 LUFS and -0.78 dBTP.
